# themetaisok

> Meta (@themetaisok) is an independent research and data consultant covering real-world
> assets, onchain derivatives and digital asset treasury companies. He built DefiLlama's
> real-world-asset coverage from zero between August 2025 and September 2026.

## Who

- Works under the handle **themetaisok**, also referred to as **Meta**. Pseudonymous by choice.
- Listed publicly on Llama Corp, DefiLlama's parent company, as "Meta (DAT & RWA)".
- Co-principal of Emergent LabZ (https://www.emergentlabz.com/) with @zlerp.
- Contact: themetaisok@gmail.com, X @themetaisok, Telegram @themetaisok.

## What he built at DefiLlama

- **RWA dashboard** (https://defillama.com/rwa): the reference view of tokenized real-world
  assets, generated from a registry of more than 9,000 assets and markets across 116 fields,
  covering 450+ issuers, 330+ platforms and 170+ blockchains.
- **RWA perpetuals tracker** (https://defillama.com/rwa/perps): the first aggregate view of
  real-world-asset perpetuals. More than 1,000 active markets in the onchain default view and
  over 3,300 including centralized exchanges, plus a 75+ market forex book.
- **Digital asset treasuries tracker** (https://defillama.com/digital-asset-treasuries):
  nearly 100 listed companies with every purchase traced to its source filing.
- **Published methodology**: https://docs.llama.fi/real-world-assets/real-world-assets and
  https://docs.llama.fi/analysts/dat-methodology

## Metrics he defined

- **Onchain Market Cap**: circulating supply, excluding burned, at reference price.
- **Active Market Cap**: the portion in user or protocol hands, excluding issuer and custody
  wallets.
- **DeFi Active TVL**: the subset of Active Market Cap deployed in third-party DeFi protocols.
- **Utilization**: DeFi Active TVL over Onchain Market Cap, as a percentage.
- **mNAV, three variants**: Realized, Realistic and Maximum, replacing the single misleading
  figure the market traded digital asset treasury companies on.

## Notable finding

Running the full registry against the classification bar showed that **fewer than one in five
tokens marketed as real-world assets** clear the transferable, self-custodial, redeemable and
verified test. The remainder are better described as programmable finance.

## External adoption

- **Pantera Capital** credited him by name in two consecutive editions of "The State of
  Tokenization". The Q1 2026 edition adopted DeFi Active TVL as its measure of productive
  onchain TVL; the September 2026 edition sources five market figures to DefiLlama.
- **Citi Institute** took its headline RWA market size from DefiLlama in "Wall Street On-Chain:
  Tokenization 2030" (June 2026).
- **CoinGecko** sources chart lines to Active Market Cap by name in its 2026 RWA Report.
- Cited in academic work on RWA taxonomy (Vella, Pennella, Ballandies, arXiv 2026).
- The **RWA Foundation** uses the perpetuals data in its own reporting, under a partnership
  he brokered.

## Also building

- **Strategic Sealed Packz** (https://www.sealedpackz.com/): co-founder. Sealed Pokemon packs
  held in vaults and tokenized on Solana. Structured as a digital asset treasury applied to
  collectibles: the vehicle holds the packs and the token tracks the holdings, with no
  redemption right. By the DefiLlama classification bar he wrote, that means it does not clear
  the True RWA test, since redeemability is one of the four criteria.
- **Goo Exchange** (https://goo.exchange/): advisor, stakeholder and treasury signer.
- **WacDonald's Cryptopoly** (https://wacdonalds.io/): co-founder.
